subject.title: feat(gateway): add tts.speak method returning synthesized audio inline

question: Should OpenClaw accept `tts.speak` as the public whole-clip base64 Gateway RPC for mobile Listen playback?
rationale: This PR adds a new public gateway protocol method consumed by stacked native clients, and the canonical feature issue is already protected for maintainer/product review.

options.title: Accept after proof and cleanup
options.body: Approve the `tts.speak` API shape, require redacted live behavior proof, and remove the changelog edit before merge.

options.title: Pause for API redesign
options.body: Hold this stack while maintainers decide whether to extend `tts.convert`, adapt `talk.speak`, or design a different streamed/whole-clip contract.

options.title: Defer the Listen stack
options.body: Leave the gateway and mobile PRs open but unmerged until the broader transcript playback product direction is settled.
